articles.title: Improving outcomes through respectful patient-centred care
articles.excerpt: From the The FIGO Committee on Health Systems Strengthening and Respectful Care, Dr Stella Dantas is joined by obstetrician Dr Jezid Miranda and midwife Professor Soo Downe to explore the importance and power of respectful, person-centred maternity care.
